system_title: SIH26012 Prototype Feature Review Priority Scoring
disclaimer: prototype heuristic—not a validated survey-priority model

priority_bands.description: Requires primary reviewer attention due to spatial overlaps, unverified source status, or geometric anomalies.
Standard feature with no detected conflicts or approved by reviewer.

rules.description: Shared dataset provenance factor (informational badge; score-neutral to prevent score distortion).
Feature intersects an adjacent village road corridor or overlapping polygon boundary.
Feature geometry has self-intersections, bowties, or violates OGC validity.
Feature geometry contains an empty or null coordinate array.
Building footprint area is unusually tiny (< 10 m²) or excessively large (> 600 m²).
AI model inference confidence is below 0.70 threshold.
A human reviewer has explicitly inspected and marked this feature approved.
Feature marked rejected by human reviewer (dispositioned).
